notes: Main disagreements: (1) phase, mostly before-course vs course-start or general vs over-time for communication and maintenance statements; resolved by the codebook definitions (communicating to students = course-start, ongoing oversight = over-time). (2) policy_type confusions between neighbouring types (P04 vs P01/P09/P10/P15, P17 vs P50/P59, P36 vs P37, P19 vs P29, P24 vs P62); resolved by re-reading the sentence and choosing the type whose definition it states (e.g. conditional bans that follow the instructor are P04, not P01). Fabrication and faculty/staff nonconformity units stayed UNCOVERED. (3) modality and unit_stance differences on informational sentences; resolved to informs/neutral unless the source commands. (4) Stance: student-guidelines page was restrict (A) vs delegates (B); final restrict because it says DO NOT use GenAI unless the instructor OKs it. (5) Alignment: two cross-aligned pairs on the AI-guidelines page and one on the syllabus page were re-paired by hand; the template list of permitted activities was split into separate units following coder B. Only-one-coder units were checked against the text and kept except 4 near-repeats dropped (all only_B: 1 on AI-guidelines, 1 on student-guidelines, 2 on Graduate Studies), so kept_only_B is 17 of 21.
